comment: P (2064,3287) is on the pen ink where the line meets the vertical grid line at the 1.0 in / 0.01 s crossing (rows 3280-3306 merged with grid lines). Centerline direction is 41.1 deg from vertical over v 3100-3210 and 46.0 deg over v 3340-3460: a gradual 4-5 deg turn spread over v 3210-3335. Conv. 7 fits: lower v 3325-3463 (139 rows, du/dv 1.037, max res 0.85) with upper v 3203-3245 (du/dv 0.912) meet at (2068,3294), turn 3.7 deg, corner about 8.5 px from P; with upper v 3223-3255 (0.867) at (2052,3279), turn 5.1 deg, corner 13 px; with upper v 3174-3210 at (2045,3272), 25 px. No variant puts the corner within 8 px and the 4-5 deg change is not visible on the 4x crop. Borderline on both tests.

P (1069,3126) is on ink. As a minimum (conv. 5): centerline max u 1069.5 over v 3114-3136; retreat 19 px on the earlier side but only 1.5 px on the later side (to 1068.0 at v 3059-3092) before it passes beyond at v 3037. Width there 4 px dark run (5-6 nearby), half >= 2 px, so 1.5 px is below the bound. The dip is the left edge alone (1066 to 1068) with the right edge fixed at 1071; centerline v 3047-3140 is straight within 0.70 px. As a knee: the bend into the vertical part has fits v 3170-3246 (du/dv -0.281) and v 3047-3120 (0.011), turn 16 deg, corner (1067.5,3155), 29 px from P (12 px or more with fits started inside the bend).

Q (1068,3074) is on ink. Centerline min u 1068.0 over v 3059-3092 (tension crest); retreat 5.5 px on the later side but only 1.5 px on the earlier side (to 1069.5 at v 3114-3136) before it passes beyond at v 3152. Width there 5 px dark run, half 2.5 px. The rebound is a one-edge wobble (right edge 1071 to 1070, left edge fixed at 1066); centerline v 3047-3140 is straight within 0.70 px.

P (1052,2301) is on ink. Centerline max u 1052.5 over v 2293-2307 (tension minimum); retreat 14 px on the earlier side, 2.0 px on the later side (to 1050.5 at v 2234-2260) before it passes beyond at v 2206. Width at the extreme 6 px dark run, half 3 px. It is a bump of the right edge (1053 to 1055) with the left edge fixed at 1050; centerline v 2261-2320 straight within 0.70 px through the mark. As a knee: the slant-to-vertical bend (fits v 2335-2387 and v 2261-2320, turn 10 deg) has its corner at (1050.5,2324), 23 px away (15-19 px with other fit starts).

P (1050,2244) is on ink. Centerline min u 1050.5 over v 2234-2251 (tension crest); retreat 20 px on the later side, 2.0 px on the earlier side (to 1052.5 at v 2281-2307) before it passes beyond at v 2330. Width there 6 px dark run, half 3 px. A bump of the left edge (1050 to 1048) with the right edge fixed at 1053; centerline v 2215-2290 straight within 0.94 px. The descent begins about 30 px later (v near 2212).

Q (1068,2145) is on ink but on a straight stretch: centerline v 2135-2188 straight within 0.98 px (du/dv -0.319) through the mark. The steepening is where the line crosses the +40 lb grid line (rows 2108-2128 merged, excluded): fits v 2135-2188 and v 2016-2104 (du/dv -0.633, 89 rows) meet at (1074.6,2126), turn 14.6 deg, corner about (1077,2126), 21 px from Q (15 px if the lower fit starts at v 2148).

P (1529,2029) is on ink. The terminal fall is a smooth arc: direction rises steadily from 10 deg off vertical (v 2075-2125) to 30 deg (v 1915), about 0.1 deg per row at the mark, and the centerline is straight within 1 px through the mark (v 1995-2048, v 2010-2072). Sharpest turning is near v 1985-1995: fits v 2000-2048 (du/dv -0.296) and v 1950-1980 (-0.471) meet at (1540.5,1991), turn 8.7 deg, corner (1541.5,1991), 40 px from P; fits at the arc ends (v 2055-2137 and v 1845-1945) give a corner near (1539.5,1995), 36 px.

Q (2133,2056) is on ink. Centerline (column midpoints) is straight within 1 px from u 2084 to 2135 (v 2054-2074, 20.7 deg above horizontal) and from u 2136 to 2164 (v 2032-2054, 38.6 deg, 36 px span); fits meet at (2133.8,2056.4), turn 18 deg, corner (2133.3,2055.5), 0.6 px from Q; the turn is visible on a 4x crop. The arc keeps turning afterward (next bend near (2165,2030), tail at about 68 deg from v 1965), so this is the first bend where the unloading eases.

Q (954,1502) is on ink where the pen line runs into the 4.0 in grid line (rows 1500-1583 merged; Q at the curve's right edge, left edge 946). Clean fits v 1584-1641 (14.1 deg from vertical) and v 1393-1499 (11.8 deg, 106 rows within 1 px) meet at (944,1471), turn 2.3-2.8 deg, corner 22-36 px from Q; a change this small is not visible on a 4x crop. The terminal shoulder is a gradual arc above v 1400 (direction 11.5 deg falling to 2 deg by v 1200) with no corner at Q.

The single Q sample (1949,3495) is on the pen line's own ink: row 3495 run u 1943-1954, continuous with the diagonal stroke above, 3 px clear of the 0 in grid line (u 1958-1963) and 7 rows above the bottom frame (v 3502-3512). Only below v 3495 does the stroke merge with the grid line and the frame.

P (1746,3440) is on ink. The start bends from 21 deg off vertical (v 3467-3482) to 61-65 deg off vertical (fits u 1709-1738, v 3418-3433, or u 1657-1726, v 3394-3427): turn 40-45 deg, clearly visible. The lower side is clean for only 16 px before it merges with the 0 lb grid line at v 3483; followed by its left edge to v 3497 (conv. 3) it is 31 px straight within 1.0 px. Fits meet near (1759,3445); corner on the centerline (bisector) about (1755,3447), 9.4-14 px from P depending on fit starts; P sits on the shallow side past the corner. If the merged rows are not accepted the lower side is too short and the corner is undefined.

P (1624,2963) is on ink but on a straight stretch: fit v 2964-3019 (55 rows, 18.3 deg off vertical) runs through the mark within 1 px. The easing bend: that fit and v 2885-2946 (10.4 deg off vertical) meet at (1620,2950), turn 8 deg, corner (1620,2950); over fit choices the corner is at v 2940-2951, 12.6 px or more later than P.

Q (1572,2474) is on ink. Centerline u 1572.5 over v 2422-2481; on the later side it retreats only 0.5 px (1573.0 at v 2380-2421) and then keeps moving left (1571.5 by v 2322); earlier side retreat 5.0 px. Width 6 px dark run, half 3 px. Centerline v 2330-2470 is straight within 0.32 px: the load rises slowly through the mark with no crest.

Fits: initial rise u 2145-2238 (v 3456-3486, 18 deg above horizontal) and the part over the -40 lb grid line v 3361-3427 (4.7 deg off vertical; the curve covers the grid line, merged run 5-6 px, so its center is the curve's within about 1 px) meet at (2121.7,3448.6), turn 67 deg; centerline corner on the bisector (2129,3443). P (2124,3434) is 10 px from it on the upper part of the bend, Q (2142,3453) 16 px on the lower side at the end of the straight rise. Neither within 8 px (P the closer); point at (2129,3443), about -37.8 lb at 0.0032 s.
